changes: Added ADRs for single database authority, secret boundary, adapter release states, and exact connection ownership.
Added adapter registry and capability contracts with verified PostgreSQL and experimental MySQL.
Added connection metadata/redaction contracts, development secret-store interface, engine-key lifecycle contract, and network-policy contract.
Preserved environment-defined legacy connections through a temporary repository.
Changed unknown connection IDs from default fallback to explicit connection_not_found.
Changed /v1/connections to return redacted public metadata instead of URL mappings.
Added PostgreSQL and MySQL service-container health coverage in CI and Compose.
